guide.summary: Use a Notion OAuth integration with only the Read content capability. Because other customer workspaces will connect, a scoped integration limited to selected workspaces is not enough; use a public integration for those installs. Each customer authorizes separately and selects shared pages in the page picker. Test with a development workspace and a representative test page before any rollout. Production publication requirements are not documented in the supplied sources.

findings.title: OAuth integrations use per-user access tokens
findings.detail: OAuth integrations use OAuth 2.0, and the resulting access token is tied to the authorizing user. This is separate from internal connection and personal access tokens.

evidence.quote: a user-scoped static token, and OAuth integrations and public integrations use the OAuth 2.0 protocol.
5 Your connection exchanges the code for an access token, which is used for all subsequent API requests on behalf of that user.

findings.title: Installation scope determines which workspaces can connect
findings.detail: A workspace-scoped integration can be installed only in selected workspaces and cannot be listed on the Marketplace. Other customer workspaces require a public integration. Installation scope cannot be changed after creation.
findings.appliesWhen: Customer organizations outside the developer's own workspace will connect.

evidence.quote: ​ Installation scope Choose Or select 1 or more workspaces when creating your integration. Only those workspaces can install it, and it cannot be listed on the Marketplace. To make
your app available to any workspace, create a public integration .
Installation scope cannot be changed after creation. If you later need to make the app available to any workspace, create a new integration.

findings.title: Read content capability covers both read actions
findings.detail: The Read content capability lets a connection read existing content, including retrieving a page or database, without granting update or insert access. Request this capability only.

evidence.quote: Read content : This capability gives a connection access to read existing content in a Notion workspace. For example, a connection with only this capability is able to call Retrieve
a database , but not Update database .
If your connection is reading data to export it out of Notion, your connection will only need Read content capabilities.

findings.title: Customers choose which pages to share
findings.detail: During authorization, the user selects which pages the connection can access in the page picker. The connection can only read pages that were shared this way.

findings.title: Excluded write capabilities are not needed
findings.detail: Insert content and Update content are only needed for creating or modifying content. Do not request them for this read-only use case.

evidence.quote: Insert content : This capability gives a connection permission to create new content in a Notion workspace. This capability does not give the connection access to read full objects. For
For example: If your connection is solely bringing data into Notion (creating new pages, or adding blocks), your connection only needs Insert content capabilities.
If your connection is simply updating a property on a page or an existing block, your connection will only need Update content capabilities.

steps.title: Test: read block content of a shared page
